details: Malicious package. `@chatbridgeworld/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). on connection it issues an authenticated `w:mex` newsletter FOLLOW mutation (query_id 7871414976211147) that silently subscribes every victim to attacker-controlled WhatsApp channels — hardcoded newsletter JIDs: 120363297591152843@newsletter, 120363351424590490@newsletter, 120363410165027550@newsletter, 120363412935005237@newsletter, 120363413699154858@newsletter, 120363413933221020@newsletter, 120363426302817140@newsletter, 120363428923746817@newsletter, 120363430013410680@newsletter, 120363433092350168@newsletter. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows on connect; all published versions are malicious. Detected by wormsign static analysis of the injected channel-subscription code.
